extension.description: Identify with colors, badges, and prefixes which folder or repository each tab comes from in a multi-root workspace.
command.openSettings.title: Customize folders
command.resync.title: Re-apply styles
config.folders.description: Style per workspace folder (the key is the folder name). Edit it with **Workspace Style: Customize folders**.
config.folders.color.description: Hex color of the name in tabs, the Explorer, and the status bar.
config.folders.emoji.description: Emoji added to the tab name.
config.folders.label.description: Text/abbreviation added to the tab name.
config.decorations.color.description: Color file names according to their folder.
config.decorations.badge.description: Show the folder badge in tabs and the Explorer.
config.tabLabels.enabled.description: Add the emoji/text to tab names through `#workbench.editor.customLabels.patterns#`.
config.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the folder of the active file in the status bar.
config.managedLabelPatterns.description: Internal use: `workbench.editor.customLabels.patterns` entries generated by the extension. Do not edit.
